overview.location: Sandston, Virginia (unincorporated Henrico County) — about 7 miles southeast of downtown Richmond, between I-64 and Williamsburg Road (US 60), reached by Airport Drive. Dedicated in 1927 as Richard Evelyn Byrd Flying Field; renamed Richmond International Airport in 1984.
overview.cargoVolume: About 223 million lb of cargo and mail in 2025; the airport is a Foreign Trade Zone
overview.distinction: Busiest airport in central Virginia and third-busiest in the state. American Airlines is the largest carrier (~19% market share, May 2025-Apr 2026); Atlanta (Delta) is the top route. Parking is more than 40% of the airport's operating revenue and the public facilities (about 10,500 spaces) regularly run 85-90% full.
overview.owner: Capital Region Airport Commission (created 1975 by the Virginia General Assembly; represents Chesterfield, Hanover and Henrico counties and the City of Richmond)
overview.totalAirlines: Allegiant, American, Breeze, Delta, Frontier, JetBlue, Southwest, Sun Country and United (plus regional partners) — current list at flyrichmond.com
overview.founded: 1927 as Richard Evelyn Byrd Flying Field; Richard E. Byrd Airport 1950; Richmond International Airport 1984. Two-level terminal completed spring 2007; Concourse A expansion completed 2021.
overview.metroAccess: No rail. GRTC Route 7 (7A/7B) serves the airport and is fare-free until further notice (per GRTC's June 2025 schedule); GRTC also runs an on-demand early-morning airport connection (4-6 AM).
overview.peopleMover: None — one two-level terminal with Concourses A and B reached on foot.

terminals.name: Main Terminal — Concourse A
terminals.notes: Expanded in 2021. Has its own TSA checkpoint (three lanes per Wikipedia). Airline gate assignments: check flyrichmond.com/terminal-map.

terminals.name: Main Terminal — Concourse B
terminals.notes: Own TSA checkpoint (expanded from four to six lanes in June 2019). Airline gate assignments: check flyrichmond.com/terminal-map.

transit: GRTC Route 7A / 7B (downtown Richmond - Nine Mile Road - airport), fare-free until further notice
GRTC On-Demand Early Morning Airport Connection (4-6 AM)

peopleMover.note: Single terminal; Concourses A and B are walkable.

groundTransportZones.rideshare: Follow the green 'Ride App Pickup' signs. Upper Departures Level for travelers without checked bags; Lower Arrivals Level (Baggage Claim) for travelers with checked bags. Choose the level in the app.
groundTransportZones.hotelShuttles: RIC does not publish a hotel-shuttle curb. The Sheraton listing says to exit the terminal and look for the hotel shuttle signs after calling the hotel.
groundTransportZones.prearranged: Limousine and group-transport operators listed on flyrichmond.com, booked in advance.

grtcBus.fare: Fare-free until further notice (GRTC Route 7A schedule, June 2025) — check ridegrtc.com for current status
grtcBus.note: Route 7 offers airport service starting at 5:00 AM; an on-demand early-morning airport connection covers 4-6 AM.

rideshare.pickupLocation: Green 'Ride App Pickup' signs — Upper Departures Level (no checked bags) or Lower Arrivals Level (checked bags)
rideshare.note: The app confirms the exact spot.

rentalCars.location: Counters near the central entrance of the terminal, Lower Level
rentalCars.note: Rental car parking and staging space is being expanded (nearly tripled, per RIC).

otherShuttles.prearrangedOperators: RIC lists 15 prearranged limousine/sedan/bus operators (e.g. Richmond Limousine 804-266-2800, James Limousine 804-273-1540, RVA Transit 804-360-2122, Winn Transportation 804-358-9466).

groundTransportation.hotelShuttles: Triply's three RIC lots are 1.1-1.6 miles from the terminal in Sandston. DoubleTree (shuttle 5 AM-12 AM) and Sheraton (4 AM-1 AM) run free shuttles — call after you collect your bags. Best Western Plus has NO shuttle: you need your own ride (rideshare, taxi or drop-off) between the hotel lot and the terminal.

parkingRates: On-airport (daily max, effective July 1, 2025): Economy $10 ($1/hr, 24/7 shuttle), Daily Garage $15 ($3/hr), Valet $30 ($2/hr after the first 24 hours), Hourly Garage $40 ($4/hr, first 60 minutes free). Cell phone lot free. Off-site via Triply: three Sandston hotel lots from ~$4.95/day.

economyLot.name: RIC Economy Parking
economyLot.location: On-airport, off Airport Drive on Ferncroft Road, about 1/2 mile from the terminal
economyLot.features: Lowest-cost on-airport option; gated lot; no reservation needed. Went from $7 to $10 on July 1, 2025.

dailyGarage.name: RIC Daily Parking (North & South Garages)
dailyGarage.serves: Main terminal (walk — directly across from the terminal)
dailyGarage.features: Garages built 1995; LED lighting replacement approved 2026. Clearance height not published.

hourlyGarage.name: RIC Hourly Parking (North & South Garages, Terminal Level 1)
hourlyGarage.features: First 60 minutes free. Meant for short meet-and-greet stays — the most expensive product for multi-day trips.

valetParking.name: RIC Valet Parking
valetParking.location: Arrivals Level, right before the terminal
valetParking.features: Can be pre-arranged by calling 804-226-3089. Accepts cash and major credit cards.

cellPhoneLot.name: Cell Phone Waiting Lot
cellPhoneLot.location: Off Terminal Drive near the South Parking Garage (about a 1-minute drive); follow the blue signs
cellPhoneLot.rules: Wait in the lot until your passenger calls to say they are curbside.

locations: Valet Parking (archived RIC page: EV charging for valet customers, first come, first served)
evCharging.note: The current RIC parking page does not list EV charging; an archived RIC page offered it to valet customers only. Tell readers to ask valet (804-226-3089).

onAirportParking.reservations: Not needed for Economy, Daily or Hourly. Valet can be pre-arranged by phone. RIC plans an online parking reservation system and a parking guidance system as part of its parking upgrades.
onAirportParking.paymentMethods: AutoExpress pay stations in the terminal or garages; major credit cards at the exit plaza; Apple Pay and Google Pay; cash at exit-plaza cashiers 24/7. Valet takes cash and major credit cards.
onAirportParking.garageServiceAreas: Hourly, Daily and Valet → walk to terminal. Economy → free 24/7 shuttle.
onAirportParking.futureParking: A conceptual new garage would add about 5,500 spaces to the current ~10,500 public spaces; RIC's CEO said to expect incremental parking rate increases over the next few years.

parkingLots.name: Best Western Plus Richmond Airport
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: No shuttle. You need your own ride between the hotel lot and the terminal (rideshare, taxi or a drop-off).
parkingLots.overview: Hotel park-and-fly lot in Sandston, minutes from RIC. No room reservation needed and no extra charge for full-size vans, pickup trucks and large SUVs. The listing has no airport shuttle.
parkingLots.notes: Lowest sellable rate at RIC on 2026-10-16 ($41.58 grand total for a 7-night Nov 2-9 stay, 8 billed days; same on Nov 9-16 and 16-23). NO SHUTTLE — never describe it as having one; frame as cheapest but you need a ride, which can eat the saving vs Economy ($80).

parkingLots.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Richmond Airport
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: To the airport every 30 minutes, 5:00 AM-12:00 AM; from the airport on demand within those hours — call 804-236-1111 or 804-892-6222 after you collect your luggage. No shuttle 12 AM-5 AM (use rideshare). Check in at the front desk with proof of booking; arrive before the 2-hour pre-flight window.
parkingLots.overview: Hotel lot minutes from RIC. Complimentary shuttle with every online reservation, no room booking required, and no extra fee for full-size vans, pickup trucks or large SUVs.
parkingLots.notes: $83.58 grand total for Nov 2-9 (8 billed days), same on all three test weeks. About $4 more than RIC Economy ($80) for the week, ~$36 less than the Daily Garage ($120). No shuttle 12-5 AM.

parkingLots.name: Sheraton Richmond Airport
parkingLots.shuttleInfo: 4:00 AM-1:00 AM every 30 minutes to the airport and on demand from the airport; no shuttle 1:00 AM-4:00 AM. Check in at the front desk. On return, call 804-226-6400 after collecting luggage, exit the terminal and wait at the hotel shuttle signs. Arrive before the 2-hour pre-flight window.
parkingLots.overview: Hotel lot close to RIC with a free shuttle included with online purchase, no room reservation needed, and no extra charge for full-size vans, pickup trucks and large SUVs.
parkingLots.notes: $83.92 grand total for Nov 2-9 (8 billed days). Closest Triply RIC lot and the longest shuttle window (4 AM-1 AM). About $4 more than RIC Economy ($80) for the week, ~$36 less than the Daily Garage ($120).

parkingLots.name: Four Points by Sheraton Richmond Airport
parkingLots.notes: Comparison only — not sold on Triply. Do not use as a CTA.

parkingLots.name: Courtyard by Marriott Richmond Airport
parkingLots.notes: Comparison only — not sold on Triply. Do not use as a CTA.

shuttleInfo: On-airport: Economy Lot free shuttle 24/7 (frequency not published). Off-site: Triply's RIC lots are 1.1-1.6 mi away in Sandston. Sheraton runs 4 AM-1 AM (none 1-4 AM); DoubleTree 5 AM-12 AM (none 12-5 AM); Best Western Plus has NO shuttle — you need your own ride. Call the hotel after collecting bags.
distanceFromCity: About 7 miles southeast of downtown Richmond via I-64.

keyDistances.toBestWesternPlus: 1.5 mi (Triply lot, Airport Square Lane — no shuttle)
keyDistances.competitiveAdvantage: RIC Economy is cheap at $10/day, so Triply's shuttle lots (DoubleTree, Sheraton) are roughly the same price as Economy for a week and ~$36 less than the $15 Daily Garage. Best Western Plus is the cheapest parking at RIC ($41.58/week) but has no shuttle.

construction2026.status: RIC plans to consolidate its two security checkpoints (Concourse A and B) into one large checkpoint with new concessions and a proposed lounge (~$253M per Aug 2026 reporting). The Commission is procuring a construction manager (RFQ, Sept 2026); enabling projects were expected from Q3 2026, construction about two years once funded. Garage LED lighting replacement ($2.16M) approved 2026.
projects: Consolidated security checkpoint (two checkpoints into one; up to 14 lanes proposed)
Garage LED lighting replacement (North and South Garages)
construction2026.travelImpact: No parking facility closures identified as of 2026-10-16 — check flyrichmond.com for current alerts before travel.

timeline.start: Enabling work expected from Q3 2026; main construction start not announced
timeline.expectedCompletion: Not announced (about two years of construction once funded)

securityAndScreening.checkpoints: Two checkpoints today — one for Concourse A (three lanes) and one for Concourse B (six lanes). Checkpoint hours are not published on flyrichmond.com.

tsaPreCheck.note: TSA PreCheck — enroll at tsa.gov/precheck; lane availability per checkpoint not published by RIC

arrivalRecommendation.domestic: 90 minutes before departure at non-peak times; 2 hours during peak travel periods (RIC guidance)
arrivalRecommendation.holidays: 2 hours or more around Thanksgiving, Christmas and spring break

lounges.other: No airline lounge is published on flyrichmond.com. A lounge is proposed as part of the consolidated-checkpoint project.

peakTravelTimes.seasonalPeak: Summer (June-August), spring break, Thanksgiving and Christmas/New Year. Parking regularly runs 85-90% full.

weatherPatterns.climate: Humid subtropical: hot, humid summers and mild winters with occasional snow and ice.
weatherPatterns.commonDisruptions: Summer thunderstorms; tropical-storm remnants (August-October); occasional winter snow and ice storms.
weatherPatterns.note: All three Triply RIC lots are outdoor hotel lots; only the airport garages are covered.

parkSleepFly.description: Hotel parking (and park-sleep-fly packages booked with the hotel) in Sandston. Triply sells parking-only at the three hotels below; room packages are booked directly with the hotel.
parkSleepFly.priceRange: Parking-only via Triply from ~$4.95/day (2026-10-16 quote); room package pricing set by each hotel

popularHotels.name: Best Western Plus Richmond Airport
popularHotels.highlight: Cheapest parking at RIC; you need your own ride to the terminal.

popularHotels.name: DoubleTree by Hilton Richmond Airport
popularHotels.shuttleHours: 5 AM-12 AM (every 30 min to airport; on demand back)
popularHotels.highlight: Free shuttle with online reservation; no oversize fee.

popularHotels.name: Sheraton Richmond Airport
popularHotels.shuttleHours: 4 AM-1 AM (every 30 min; on demand back)
popularHotels.highlight: Closest Triply lot; longest shuttle window; 24/7 front desk.

savingsComparison.scenario: 7-night trip (Nov 2-9, 2026, 10 AM drop-off / 2 PM pickup — Triply bills 8 days), quoted 2026-10-16. On-airport figures assume 8 days at the daily max (actual airport billing may differ for partial days; valet charges $2/hr after the first 24 hours).

bestWesternPlusRichmondAirport.savingsVsEconomy: ~$38 saved before the cost of getting to the terminal
bestWesternPlusRichmondAirport.caveat: NO shuttle — two rideshare/taxi trips (or a drop-off and pickup) are needed, which can erase the saving vs Economy

savingsComparison.keyDifference: RIC's Economy Lot is cheap at $10/day with a 24/7 shuttle, so Triply's shuttle lots (DoubleTree, Sheraton) cost about $4 more than Economy for a week — anchor savings against the $15 Daily Garage (~$36 saved), $30 Valet and $40 Hourly. Best Western Plus is the cheapest parking at RIC but has no shuttle; it wins when someone can drop you off.

uniqueFeatures.byrdField: Originally Richard Evelyn Byrd Flying Field (1927), named for the polar explorer and Virginia native.
uniqueFeatures.parkingRevenue: Parking is over 40% of RIC's operating revenue; July 2025 brought the first across-the-board rate increase in 22 years.
uniqueFeatures.fareFreeBus: GRTC Route 7 to the airport has been fare-free.
uniqueFeatures.armyGuard: Hosts a Virginia Army National Guard Aviation Support Facility (224th Aviation Regiment).
uniqueFeatures.foreignTradeZone: The airport is a Foreign Trade Zone.

emergencyContacts.emergency: 911 — state you are at Richmond International Airport
